text:
sam: heads up - deploybot blocked global rollout for api-gateway:2025.07.01-rc due to mismatched SBOM provenance between artifact and registry.
deploybot: [automated] Deployment halted: SBOM provenance mismatch for redwood/api-gateway:2025.07.01-rc (policy SBN-7)
supplychain-bot: comparison: artifact SBOM signed by key ID: key-78abc - registry record claims key ID: key-12def
tasha: that smells like buildcache mismatch/CI registry flakiness. Anyone touched signing keys?
sec-bot: verification: signature present on artifact but key mismatch flagged. Could be rotated key or wrong key used by CI.
legal: policy requires chain-of-trust validation. If key rotation, need proof of authorized rotation and update to trust store.
sam: mitigation options: 1) revert to previous signed artifact 2) re-sign artifact with current trust store (requires attestation) 3) rollback to previous stable
release-coordinator: change window in 30m. Re-sign path will take ~45m including reupload and re-run scans. Rollback ~10m.
tasha: do we have an approved key rotation ticket? I see an infra key-rotation PR merged yesterday but without release notes. @infra?
sec-bot: infra rotation flagged: KEYROT-2025-06 merged by infra-ci-bot. Need maintainers to confirm authorized rotation.
infra-bot: key rotation scheduled and authorized by sig-ops. Rotation comment: "scheduled rotation of build signing key"
legal: we can accept re-signing if infra provides attestation that rotation was authorized and the rotated key is in the trust store before global rollout.
sam: decision: perform regional rollback to reduce blast radius and buy time. Keep us-east canary running.
deploybot: Executing rollback for eu: `/deploy rollback --env=eu --service=api-gateway --to-tag=2025.06.25-stable`
deploybot: EU rollback complete.
release-coordinator: infra/maintainers please provide key attestation and add rotation notes to KEYROT-2025 ticket.
tasha: working with infra now. Re-sign path: we can build + sign with new key and attach attestation file. Will take ~40m.
sec-bot: note: policy SBN-7 requires attestation file `rotation-attestation.json` included in artifact metadata.
legal: legal confirms acceptance of re-sign + attestation rather than full rollback if provided within change window.
release-coordinator: I'll hold global promote pending attestation.
infra-bot: attestation updated in KEYROT-2025: "rotation authorized by sig-ops, key published to trust store at 2025-07-01T08:15Z"
tasha: re-sign build now. CI: `BUILD OK` `cosign sign` `upload`
supplychain-bot: new SBOM attestation attached: rotation-attestation.json present
sec-bot: verification: artifact signature key matches registry trust store; attestation verified. Policy SBN-7 PASS.
deploybot: Artifact verified. Ready to promote.
sam: proceed with global promote. /deploy promote --env=global --service=api-gateway --tag=2025.07.01-rc
deploybot: Global promote started. Regions 1/6 complete.
deploybot: Global promote complete.
release-coordinator: please add note to release docs referencing key rotation attestation for audit.
legal: will review attestation for compliance record.
 (end)
